Community outreach

Support from our community.

People and organisations support HUP in many ways, from food and clothing donations to volunteering and practical help. We appreciate everyone who continues to come forward.

SUPPORT THAT CONTINUES

There’s more than one way to help.

Individuals, local organisations and public-sector partners continue to support HUP. Every offer starts with a conversation about what the shelter needs.

Share what you can

Ask about food and clothing donations, then agree on a useful donation and a drop-off time.

Discuss an item donation ↗

Give your time

Offer your skills or arrange a group activity with the shelter. Tell the team when and how you would like to help.

Ask about volunteering ↗

Keep supporting the work

If you or your organisation would like to help regularly, talk to HUP about an ongoing arrangement.

Discuss a partnership ↗

Local collaboration

Sunnyside police assisted HUP employees with food preparation.

Historical event: July 2022. Figures and photographs from Ron Sibiya / Rekord. These are not current annual impact figures.

People who took part

Volunteers cleaned the park before meals were distributed. Sunnyside police officers helped HUP employees prepare food. The event was covered by Rekord on 20 July 2022.
